fit_contract.categorical: training-vocabulary one-hot encoding with fixed missing and unknown buckets
fit_contract.missingness: one indicator per candidate feature; value representation excluded above 40 percent training missingness
fit_contract.high_cost: nearest-rank 80th percentile of training labels; greater-than-or-equal classification

artifacts.preprocessor.json: fitted parameters, training-only fit evidence, feature columns, and policies
artifacts.feature_matrix.csv: one row per frozen split snapshot; snapshot_id plus transformed feature columns only
artifacts.target_metadata.csv: unaltered target, split, cap-sensitivity metadata, and training-derived high-cost flag
artifacts.preprocessing_manifest.json: input and output hashes, counts, status, and prohibited claims

target_metadata_fields.snapshot_id: uuid string; foreign key to the release snapshot and split assignment
target_metadata_fields.target_amount_local_nominal: unaltered nonnegative AHS label in nominal USD
target_metadata_fields.response_cap_regime: frozen cap-regime marker from the split
target_metadata_fields.is_high_cost: target greater than or equal to the training-only threshold
